quote: Hazina gave us a 72-hour head start before the 2024 El Niño floodwaters reached Tana River settlements. Getting automated M-PESA cash assistance directly to at-risk families before the inundation meant families evacuated with dignity and saved their livestock.

Transitioning from paper registers to BomaCare mobile tablets turned an agonizing 14-day aid verification process into a 6-hour operation. Families receive emergency cash in their mobile wallets safely without standing in dangerous heat queues.

Kenya Red Cross Digital Transformation is setting a benchmark across Africa. Their predictive AI models and open GIS layers demonstrate how national societies can move from reactive disaster response to anticipatory resilience.

MamaAfya on my smartphone allows me to track 45 expectant mothers in remote pastoralist villages. When danger signs appear, the app immediately dispatches a Red Cross emergency ambulance to transport mothers to skilled care.

RedPulse detected statistical cholera anomalies in Mandera 11 days before laboratory reports confirmed the outbreak. That early signal enabled us to deploy targeted water purification kits and prevent widespread community transmission.
organization: Ministry of Health Outbreak Response Unit
